translations.web: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.
translations.bsb: May God give to you the dew of heaven and the richness of the earth— an abundance of grain and new wine.
translations.kjv: Therefore God give thee of the dew of heaven, and the fatness of the earth, and plenty of corn and wine:
translations.asv: And God give thee of the dew of heaven, And of the fatness of the earth, And plenty of grain and new wine.
